items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: I was still running the West End which we haven't talked about, a night club that had jazz seven nights a week for 17 years with very heavy hitting people like Jo Jones and others and Dizzy Gillespie and Benny Carter and others.

ctx.x: And is it something that you usually initiate or is it a record company coming to you?

Well originally I offered my services as a provider of the rarer stuff with the ability to convert it into a suitable sound for their reissues or first time issues. You know like I had actually a completely different system of doing 78 transfers in the mid-seventies, which I wonder if I ever again will be able to do and then find out if there was anything to it. But I used to do my re-mastering — KCR at that time was still off the air. This is how long ago it was because I’m sure it’s over 25 years ago, was off…
and also has producer capabilities. Well that’s one stop shopping. Let’s do him. And I think that’s how it happened.
